the DRGP-VSSGP is the best performing method in all cases, followed by the DRGP-SSGP.

the VSSDRGP is the best performing model in terms of predictive performance and the VSSDRGPR is the best performing in terms of computational cost, while being comparable in predictive performance to the other models.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an improved variational sparse spectrum approximation for Gaussian Processes and combine it with a recurrent framework to create new Deep Recurrent GPs.
we introduce a novel class of DRGP models, which can be used in all stationary cases and are able to outperform current state of the-art models.
we provide an extension to the RGP model that is more accurate and has a wider applicability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of the (V)SS approximation with the RGP structure leads to a more accurate model, while the combination with the (V)I approximation leads to a more efficient model.
the (V)SS approximation of GPs can be used in a recurrent fashion and is able to model sequential data with high accuracy.
the (V)SS approximation is more accurate than the Nyström approximation in terms of prediction performance.
